answer: The most convincing sybil defense is vested payout scheduling: every agent stakes an identity bond and earns rewards that vest linearly across many epochs, like a prism splitting a single payment into dozens of delayed installments. A new agent sees only a thin slice of each epoch's payout immediately; the horizon for full ownership stretches months out, so an attacker spinning up thousands of comets - flash-farm accounts that blaze bright and burn out - forfeits unvested balances the moment accounts are abandoned or flagged.
